claims: On Tuesday, April 7, 2026, Wendy's is offering a free Small Hot & Crispy Fry paired with a Small Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty.
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry is available in-store at participating U.S. locations.
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry does not require a purchase.
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry does not require app usage.
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry provides a free Small Fry and Small Classic Frosty (Chocolate or Vanilla).
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry is in-restaurant only.
The April 7 Free Frosty & Fry has a limit of one free item per person.
Purchasing a 2026 Frosty Key Tag gets a free Jr. Frosty with any purchase for the remainder of the year.
2026 Frosty Key Tags are available in-store.
2026 Frosty Key Tags are available in the app.
2026 Frosty Key Tags are available online.
2026 Frosty Key Tags support the Dave Thomas Foundation for Adoption.
Participating Wisconsin locations offer a free Small Frosty within 24 hours of a Milwaukee Bucks win.
